info.name: LifeReady Training - Part 1 API Tests
info.description: Import into Postman, set the admin variables, then run the collection after creating the admin account with npm run seed:admin.

exec: pm.test('Administrator can sign in', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

body.raw:

exec: pm.test('Administrator creates a class', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Public class list is returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Administrator updates the class', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().capacity).to.eql(20); });
pm.test('Administrator deletes the class', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
